exposure: Preferred mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean)
outcome: Maternal views on induction of labor
cohort: 719 pregnant women in their third trimester recruited from outpatient clinics at an academic institution.
finding: Women's views towards modes of delivery and peripartum outcomes varied significantly based on their age, education level, and preferred mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Women who preferred vaginal delivery had greater valuations of perineal laceration and urinary incontinence compared to those who preferred cesarean delivery.
